name: farewatch
description: FestiveFare - AI-powered Indian Festive Flight Price Predictor & WhatsApp/Telegram Alert Engine

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit' }); const f = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'frontend', stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install

author: Rajveer Singh
